summary: Verified per-designation Operations sub-tab access feature (Feb 2026). 5/5 backend tests pass (designation CRUD with new fields + /auth/me designation_config enrichment). 4/4 frontend tests pass (F3 modal with 6 toggles + Projects view/edit picker, F4 projects-view-edit-toggle visible for super_admin, F5 nav-approvals visible in sidebar, F6 auto-refresh fires initial + background poll at ~12s + on window focus). One unrelated UI bug detected on the Login page: `toast is not defined` ReferenceError in handleSubmit that surfaces a red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay on submit — login itself still completes server-side, but the overlay blocks the post-login redirect (we had to navigate manually to /approvals).

ui_bugs.issue: Uncaught ReferenceError: 'toast is not defined' thrown from handleSubmit (bundle.js:271413:7). Triggers React error overlay (red full-screen 'Uncaught runtime errors:'). Login API call itself succeeds (cookie set), but the JS exception prevents the post-login navigate(); user is stuck on /login until they manually navigate. Likely a missing import { toast } from 'sonner' (or react-hot-toast) in /app/frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.js (or wherever handleSubmit lives).

action_items: Fix the `toast is not defined` ReferenceError on the Login page by importing toast (most likely `import { toast } from 'sonner'`) in the file that exports handleSubmit. After the fix, login should redirect automatically without the red overlay.
critical_code_review_comments: Login page throws an uncaught ReferenceError on every submit; this also blocks any Playwright/E2E test that expects automatic post-login navigation. Should be treated as a regression — must be fixed before next release.
Designation update endpoint correctly persists only the new fields when others are omitted (None-checked) — good. Verified via dedicated update test.
/auth/me correctly returns `designation_config: null` if user's designation has no matching row, else returns the full key set. Type contract is solid (bool/string/list).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (4/4) — all per-designation feature tests pass; separate Login JS bug noted

seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up two TEST_ prefixed designations during backend run (auto-deleted on teardown).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested per-designation sub-tab access tests (F1–F6) pass. The only outstanding issue is the Login page `toast is not defined` JS error (pre-existing? worth confirming git blame). To re-test E2E login flow after the fix, just remove the manual `page.goto('/approvals')` fallback in the frontend script and confirm post-login redirect happens automatically. Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_designation_subtab_config.py and run cleanly via `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_designation_subtab_config.py -v`.
rca of the issue: Login JS error RCA — `handleSubmit` calls `toast.error(...)` (or similar) without importing `toast`. The minified bundle line 271413:7 reveals 'toast is not defined'. Reproduction: open /login, fill any credentials, click Sign In — the dev-mode error overlay appears immediately. Mitigation: add the missing import (likely `import { toast } from 'sonner';` or `import toast from 'react-hot-toast';`) at the top of the LoginPage component file.
